title: Slow arpeggio (broken chord played as melody)
purpose: confirms an arpeggio played slowly enough — with each note fully released before the next attacks — classifies as melody. Together with T2.1, brackets the CHORD_CLUSTER_WINDOW value.
expected_prose:
No two attacks fall within CHORD_CLUSTER_WINDOW
(spacing is 500ms >> any reasonable window). Sounding-set never
contains more than one note. Three discrete melody events.
